module_summary: AXI-stream N:1 frame multiplexer: at frame start latches the select input, passes the chosen input's beats through an indexed mux into a registered output stage with skid buffer, and releases at tlast.

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: latched input index steering all current_s_* mux slices

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: in-frame lock; blocks reselect until tlast, gates output valid

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: requested input port, captured into select_reg at frame start

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: permits starting a new frame selection

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: per-input valid; selected bit drives current_s_tvalid

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: ready asserted only on selected input from s_axis_tready_reg

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: concatenated input data sliced by select_reg

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: output valid from output register stage

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: output ready; drives skid transfers and internal ready

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: mux output: selected input data slice

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: internal registered ready from output stage to mux

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: internal valid of selected beat into output stage

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: skid register holding beat while output stalls

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: skid occupied; gates internal ready and temp-to-output move

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: loads mux output into output registers

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: loads mux output into skid registers

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: moves skid contents to output registers

groups.name: Frame select control
groups.description: Latches select at frame start, holds until tlast, drives per-input ready

groups.name: Input mux
groups.description: Indexed slices of concatenated inputs by select_reg

groups.name: Output register stage
groups.description: Registered AXI-stream output with internal ready

groups.name: Skid buffer
groups.description: Temp registers absorb a beat when output stalls
